title: finance.read_summary input
description: Bounded month window for the local-first finance.read_summary operation (LIFE-007, Actual Budget). R0 pure: the summary path performs zero writes and never touches the approval gate. Only a month window is accepted — there is no account scoping in v1; the summary is a whole-budget narrowed aggregate. A malformed month is a typed invalid outcome; a missing or non-Actual budget file is typed unavailable, never an empty success. Credential material never travels in arguments.
